reels.title: SPIRIT WEEK! Hail, New Mexico! | Mateo + a guest cheer from Ray
reels.text: Mateo Sandoval takes on the Lobo fight song, spoken word, with a disclaimer. Then Ray Abernathy, in full Ohio cheer gear, explains why Mateo is taking the risk for his Silver and Red.
